boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations on downtown corridors within a practical walk of MSOE.

cards.title: Cathedral Square Park
cards.subtitle: E. Wells Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the 2.1-acre county park and look for its fountain and play area; it sits at 520 E. Wells Street.
cards.short_summary: A compact downtown park with documented fountain and play-area features.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee County lists Cathedral Square at 520 E. Wells St. and its park map identifies a fountain and tot-lot/play area.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor county park; check park notices before a visit.

cards.title: Pabst Theater
cards.subtitle: E. Wells Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the 144 E. Wells Street facade, then check the official calendar if you want to pair the stop with a ticketed show.
cards.short_summary: An 1895 downtown theater with a documented European-opera-house backdrop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pabst Theater Group identifies the Pabst Theater at 144 E. Wells St. and says it was built in 1895.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is public; performances and entry depend on the event.

cards.title: Milwaukee City Hall
cards.subtitle: E. Wells Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the public building at 200 E. Wells Street as a landmark stop, and visit weekday business hours for city-service access.
cards.short_summary: A civic landmark directly north of Red Arrow Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Milwaukee lists City Hall at 200 E. Wells Street and gives Monday–Friday business hours of 8 a.m.–4:45 p.m.
cards.source_title: Directions to City Hall, Hours and Directory
cards.access_notes: City Hall business hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4:45 p.m.; individual department hours may differ.

cards.title: Red Arrow Park
cards.subtitle: N. Water Street corridor
cards.notes: Find the Red Arrow memorial at 920 N. Water Street; in winter, check whether the Slice of Ice rink has reopened for the season.
cards.short_summary: A downtown park with a military memorial and seasonal ice rink.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee County identifies Red Arrow Park at 920 N. Water St.; its Slice of Ice page describes the seasonal rink there.
cards.source_title: Slice of Ice in Red Arrow Park
cards.access_notes: The county currently marks Slice of Ice closed for the season; outdoor park conditions vary.

cards.title: Milwaukee RiverWalk
cards.subtitle: Milwaukee River corridor
cards.notes: Join the downtown RiverWalk near Water Street and follow the riverfront route toward public art and the Third Ward.
cards.short_summary: A downtown riverfront walking route supported by the city’s Riverwalk district.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Milwaukee Riverwalk district covers the downtown river corridor from Pleasant Street south to Clybourn Street.
cards.access_notes: Use established public walkways and observe any posted closures.

cards.title: Milwaukee Public Market
cards.subtitle: N. Water Street corridor
cards.notes: Browse the independent merchants at 400 N. Water Street, or use the posted hours to time a food, coffee, or retail stop.
cards.short_summary: An all-ages indoor market with food and retail vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee Public Market lists its address as 400 N. Water St., describes independent merchants, and states it is a place for all ages to gather.
cards.source_title: Milwaukee Public Market hours and contact
cards.access_notes: Market hours listed: Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. Guests under 18 require a supervising adult.

cards.title: Pere Marquette Park
cards.subtitle: N. Plankinton Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk to the river edge at 900 N. Plankinton Avenue and use the park’s west-bank access point as a riverside orientation stop.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown park with documented Milwaukee Urban Water Trail access.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee County identifies Pere Marquette Park as a west-bank access point for the Milwaukee Urban Water Trail.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park; water activities require appropriate equipment and conditions.

cards.title: Central Library
cards.subtitle: W. Wisconsin Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter at Central Library and take the free Saturday public tour from the rotunda to see the landmark building’s historic interior.
cards.short_summary: A landmark library offering free Saturday public tours.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee Public Library lists Central Library at 814 W. Wisconsin Ave. and offers free public tours on Saturdays at 11 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Free public tours begin in the rotunda Saturdays at 11 a.m.; library hours vary by day.

cards.title: Zeidler Union Square
cards.subtitle: W. Michigan Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the one-acre park at 301 W. Michigan Street as a downtown walking pause and look for scheduled public events before you go.
cards.short_summary: A named county park and event space in the downtown core.
cards.evidence_claim: Milwaukee County lists Zeidler Union Square at 301 W. Michigan St. and identifies it as a premium event-space park.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park; special events may require permits or affect access.

cards.title: Marcus Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: N. Water Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk past the performing-arts campus at 929 N. Water Street, then check its official schedule for an age-appropriate performance.
cards.short_summary: A major Water Street performing-arts destination with programmed events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marcus Performing Arts Center’s official events listing identifies Uihlein Hall at 929 N. Water St., Milwaukee.
cards.access_notes: Exterior access is public; performance access, timing, and ticket requirements vary by event.
